svg.title: Timely success with timer and HTTP waits at 2,000 offered requests per second

cc:Work.dc:title: Timely success with timer and HTTP waits at 2,000 offered requests per second
cc:Work.dc:description: Light and heavy panels compare cap 0 and 6. One compute worker for fiber offload; two virtual-thread carriers. Each point is the median of three per-run timely-success fractions using all offered requests of its class. Whiskers show the observed range, not a confidence interval. Points are not joined.
